Language Reference

Each Borrowed Tongues release uses a different constructed language. These pages document the vocabulary, grammar, and derivation choices made for each release — including new constructions coined when canon had gaps.

  • High Valyrian Valyrio Muño Ōreloso

    Created by David J. Peterson · Game of Thrones / House of the Dragon (HBO)

    59 words documented · 23 new constructions

    →
  • Suh Ankripton

    Created by David J. Peterson · Superman (2025 film)

    69 words documented · 54 new constructions

    →
  • Klingon tlhIngan Hol

    Created by Marc Okrand · Star Trek franchise

    13 words documented · 8 new constructions

    →
  • Rihan

    Created by Diane Duane · Rihannsu novel series (My Enemy, My Ally; The Romulan Way; Swordhunt; Honor Blade; The Empty Chair) · also known as Romulan

    37 words documented · 12 new constructions
